summary.text: This resolution supports the goals of National Catholic Schools Week, an event cosponsored by the National Catholic Educational Association and the U.S. Conference of Catholic Bishops and established to recognize the contributions of Catholic elementary and secondary schools in the United States.

title: Supporting the contributions of Catholic schools in the United States and celebrating the 52nd annual National Catholic Schools Week.
